title: CATL Begins Trial Production at 100 GWh Debrecen, Hungary Cell Plant
detail: CATL started trial production on the first two cell manufacturing lines at its Debrecen, Hungary plant after clearing regulatory hurdles tied to an August nickel-exposure safety incident and obtaining its occupancy permit. Once ramped, the site will be CATL's largest manufacturing base outside China at 100 GWh planned capacity, supplying major European automakers; the plant has separately produced 537,000 battery modules since late 2024.

media.caption: CATL's Debrecen, Hungary cell manufacturing plant begins trial production

title: Li Auto Targets Small-Batch Solid-State Battery Integration for 2027–2028
detail: Li Auto senior director Liu Zhimin said the automaker is laying groundwork for solid-state battery technology, targeting small-batch vehicle integration in 2027 or 2028, with mature mass production not expected until roughly 2032–2033. The company cited lifespan, charging performance, and cost as the core unresolved challenges, and said its entire lineup is moving to in-house-developed battery packs.

media.caption: Li Auto outlines solid-state battery integration timeline
